reply: Thank you for telling us that $2,500.00 was withdrawn from your checking account without your permission and that you were told the purchase was authorized. We understand how upsetting this answer is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please ask in writing for the reasons for the decision and the information it relied on, and keep a record of when you first reported the withdrawal. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that an alert about a loss linked to your bankruptcy remains on your accounts after the discharge, and that you were not told if or when it will be removed. We understand how this affects your experience as a customer. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep a copy of your discharge order and ask in writing whether the alert has an end date. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us about the $630.00 charge made in a city you have never visited, and that your disputes have not been successful despite a police report. We understand why you feel your money is not safe. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep your police report, dispute letters and the date you first reported the charge. Unauthorized debit card transactions carry added protections when reported promptly. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your password was changed without your action and that, when you called, you were asked to read out a code from a text that warned never to share it. We understand why that worried you. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team, including how identity checks are done. Please contact the bank only through a number you trust, and keep a record of your calls and branch visit. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

We are sorry for the loss of your brother. Thank you for explaining that, as administrator of his estate, you have not received clear answers about the funds in his account, and that you found a withdrawal you questioned. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team, together with your fraud report. Please keep copies of your appointment papers, the statement showing the withdrawal and your emails. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that you received a letter saying your business account will be closed unless you call, and that you have spent long periods on hold trying to do so. We understand how hard this is while working more than one job. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep the letter and a note of the dates and times you called, and ask whether you can respond in writing instead. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a withdrawal was made with your lost debit card while you were reporting it, and that your claim was denied four months later. We understand why you disagree with how the evidence was described. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep a record of your first call, the ID and photo you sent and any dates you were given, and ask in writing for the evidence the decision relied on. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a transaction posted earlier than expected, leading to a negative balance and overdraft fees, and that this has happened before. We understand your frustration with how posting times affect fees. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please list each fee with its date and the related transaction, and keep your statements for that cycle. Please do not share full account numbers by email. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that $3,200.00 and $670.00 were charged to your debit card while you were at work, and that your claim was denied because a PIN was used. We are sorry about the loss of your emergency fund. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep the fraud alert texts, a record of your work hours that day and the denial letter, and ask in writing for the evidence used. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your business checking account was closed and that the check for the final balance of $900.00 has not arrived despite several calls. We understand your frustration at the lack of follow-up. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please keep the closure letter, the final statement and a note of each call, and ask for written confirmation of the date and address the check was sent to. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a hold was placed on your check deposit after you were told the funds would be available the next day, and that you are facing eviction. We are sorry for the pressure this puts on you and your children. Your complaint has been logged for review by the deposit operations team. Please keep the paperwork showing where the funds came from, and ask for the hold notice in writing with the release date. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your bank confirmed the charges were fraud and reversed them, but the reporting company still shows the unpaid item. We understand how this is affecting your applications. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. When a company learns it sent wrong information, it must tell the reporting companies it sent it to, so keep the bank's letter and send a copy with your dispute. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your concern that a five business day hold on your deposit from your mother's estate is excessive. Your complaint has been logged for review by the deposit operations team. Holds can differ depending on how and where a check is deposited, so please ask for the hold notice in writing with the reason given and the date the funds become available, and keep a copy for your records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that refunds you did not authorize, linked to a compromised account, were applied to your negative balance instead of being returned. We understand your concern about the risk to your other account. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please list each incoming refund with its date and amount, and keep any messages from the other company about the compromise. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have been unable to withdraw your funds for a home closing, and that a recent attempt to bring your account to zero and close it was refused. We understand how long this has gone on. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please ask in writing for the steps needed to close the account and receive your balance, and keep a record of each branch visit. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for raising your concerns that a bonus and a deposit were affected when your accounts were closed, and that amounts were later changed. We understand you want these transactions explained. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please list the transactions you believe were changed, with their dates and amounts, and keep the printed records you have. Asking for your final statements in writing will also help the review. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were charged $140.00 in overdraft fees even though you transferred money the same day to cover your purchases. We understand your frustration with how the timing was handled. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please list each fee and transaction with its time, and keep your statement. You can reduce future fees by monitoring your balance and opting out of debit card overdraft. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that the activation number on your replacement debit card led to people asking you to pay for a promotion before activating it. We understand why this was alarming. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please do not pay anything or share card details on that number. Contact the bank using a number from its official website or your statement, and keep the card envelope and sticker. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your concern about where escalation staff are based and how your account information is protected, and about the service you have received. We understand why you want an explanation. Your complaint has been logged for review by the customer relations team. Please note the date and time of the call. If you ever suspect your account has been compromised, contact the bank through a number you trust and review your recent activity. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your account was restricted over a small overdraft on the day your social security payment arrived, leaving you without money for rent, food and medical travel. We are very sorry for the hardship this is causing. Your complaint has been logged for urgent review by the account services team. Please ask how quickly the check can be sent, and you may want to ask other banks about second-chance or low-cost accounts. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that the hold on your payroll check was extended on the day it was due to be released. We understand how important your pay is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the deposit operations team, including the reason for the extension. Please ask for the hold notice in writing. If your employer can pay by direct deposit, payroll funds are generally available by the next business day. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you asked in writing to close your card and remove the $95.00 annual fee, but the card stayed open and new fees and interest were added. We understand your frustration after being told it would be escalated. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team. Please keep a copy of your letter and a note of each call, and check your statements while the account remains open. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your business card of over twenty years was closed without warning after payments made with money orders, and that your rewards points have not been released. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including the points balance. Please keep copies of your letters and the money order records, and ask in writing what happens to the points and how future payments can be made. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your autopay settings and stored bank details disappeared from the website, causing missed payments, late fees and credit reporting. We understand your frustration that this has happened again. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team. Please keep screenshots or confirmations of each autopay you set up, and check your statements each month to confirm the payment is scheduled. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that unknown contact details were added to your account, that you secured it, and that the account was then limited without a clear reason. We understand the difficulty of losing access to your balances and statements. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account security team. Please keep the alert emails and any replies you received, and contact the company only through its official app or website. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were offered a $100.00 discount for opening the card but received only $50.00, and that interest has since grown on the remaining balance. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including the offer terms. Please send a written billing dispute about the balance and keep any record of the offer and of your calls. The card issuer must acknowledge a written billing dispute within a set time. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $1,500.00 card payment you made was later shown as missing, and that your payment account has stayed frozen for nearly two years while interest grows. We understand how frustrating it is to keep starting over. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team. Please keep the bank letter and statements showing the payment was not reversed, and ask for a single case reference. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you sent a document as payment of $5,000.00, that it was received, and that your account was not credited, leading to late payment reporting. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including how the item was processed. Please keep the certified mail receipt and copies of what you sent, and ask in writing how the item was handled and what balance remains. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that a charged-off card account you do not recognize appears on your credit report, while the card issuer says you have no open accounts. We understand how much this affects you. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team. Accounts can be listed under unfamiliar names, so please request your free credit reports and dispute the entry if it is not yours. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a card payment appeared as posted in the app for several days before it was shown as unavailable, and that you made decisions based on that balance. We understand the stress this has caused. Your complaint has been logged for review by the card services team, including how the payment status was shown. Please keep screenshots of the app balance and the dates involved. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
